svg.title: Expansion is not the same as acceleration
svg.desc: Radiation and dust scale factors grow with downward curvature; a positive cosmological-constant model grows exponentially. Each ideal flat model is normalized to a(1)=1. The exponential curve uses H=2/3 in these plot units; it does not begin with a finite-time big bang in this slicing. These are separate single-component universes.

g.text: 31 / EXPANSION IS NOT THE SAME AS ACCELERATION
